sections.title: The platform does the heavy lifting. We do the rest.
sections.body: Buzznerd services run on the same AI, inventory and customer data as your products — so marketing targets real units, content feeds the same AI answering your leads, and every integration writes back to one record. Start with any service, on your existing site or a Buzznerd one.

items.question: What services does Buzznerd offer?
items.answer: Four core services: AI-Driven Marketing built on your live inventory, Content Restructuring for AIO so buyers and AI understand your pages, Custom Workflows & Integrations that connect your DMS, CRM and systems, and a free AI Presence Score that shows how AI search sees your dealership.

items.question: What is AI-Driven Marketing?
items.answer: Dealership advertising built around live inventory and measurable performance — Google Ads, Meta remarketing and landing pages tied to real units, so spend follows what's actually on your lot and every campaign is traceable to results.

items.question: What is Content Restructuring for AIO?
items.answer: It takes weak, outdated or thin dealership content and rebuilds it so it performs across traditional search, AI answer engines and customer-facing pages — the same structure that helps AI cite and recommend your dealership.

items.question: Can Buzznerd connect to my DMS and CRM?
items.answer: Yes. We build custom workflows and integrations that connect websites, inventory providers, CRM, DMS, ecommerce and marketing platforms — working with Karmak and CDK plus custom DMS and ERP integrations.

items.question: How much does an AI Presence Score cost?
items.answer: It's free. The AI Presence Score runs in about 30 seconds and emails you a full report scored across AEO, AIO, SEO and GEO.

items.question: Do I need a Buzznerd website to use these services?
items.answer: No. Buzznerd services can work on your existing site and systems. They run best alongside a Buzznerd AI Website and the AI Platform, but marketing, content, integrations and the AI Presence Score can all start independently.

sections.title: Let's put it to work for your store
sections.body: Book a 20-minute demo and we'll show you which services will move the needle — or run your free AI Presence Score right now.
